name: Aurora
notes: Between Worlds is cast once at t=0 for its shockwave damage: its cooldown (100-140s post-effect) never comes back around in a 15s fight, so it is never recast.

Twofold Hex is cast on cooldown and manually recast 0.1 s later every time (the earliest the recast is allowed), rather than waiting for the mark's 3.5 s auto-expiry, to maximize the number of full Q cycles landed.
The Weirding is cast on cooldown throughout the fight.
Basic attacks are thrown between casts (Aurora is a ranged auto-attacker); they, and every damaging ability cast, apply a stack of Spirit Abjuration.

Spirit Abjuration: stacks cap at 3 and refresh their 4 s timer on each application; the 3rd stack consumes all three and deals the bonus max-health magic damage as its own instance, then the stack count resets to 0.

The fight's stationary dummy counts as an enemy champion (per the fight rules), so Spirit Abjuration's monster damage cap is not applied to it; its bonus damage scales uncapped off the target's maximum health.
Spirit Abjuration's per-second heal from exorcised Spirits, and W's invisibility/movement speed/ghosting, are pure survivability/utility with no damage-fight relevance and are not modeled.
Mana costs (Q 60, W 80, E 80, R 100) are not modeled: at level 16 the mana pool comfortably covers one R, roughly two Q cycles and two E casts inside a 15 s fight.
